note: EVIDENCE-BASED ESG-improver universe: 52 real ASEAN-listed companies across the 5 markets (Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand, Philippines), each selected for DOCUMENTED sustained ESG improvement or leadership over 2019-2023 (DJSI / S&P Global Sustainability Yearbook & Industry Movers, FTSE4Good, MSCI ESG upgrades, Sustainalytics risk-rating drops, IDX ESG Leaders / SRI-KEHATI, SET ESG Ratings, ASEAN CG Scorecard). Each constituent carries an `esg_basis` (the specific evidence + improvement signal), a `source_url`, and a `confidence` flag. THIS IS A DEFENSIBLE PROXY, not the authoritative backtest basket: the real foundation is the team's own 'ESG Momentum 2.0' backtest of '52 ASEAN companies with consistent ESG improvement 2019-2023' (positive ESG-score 5-year CAGR), which is not publicly published — so these names are reconstructed from public ESG evidence and will NOT exactly reproduce that basket. `esg_cagr_2019_2023` is intentionally left blank (we do not have the per-name ESG-score CAGR and do not fabricate it). The loader keeps company/ticker/exchange/country/sector/esg_cagr; esg_basis/source_url/confidence ride as documentation. Tickers are EXCHANGE:CODE; sector strings are descriptive, not GICS-exact.
selection: documented sustained ESG improvement or leadership 2019-2023 (DJSI, S&P Global Yearbook/Industry Movers, FTSE4Good, MSCI/Sustainalytics rating upgrades, national ESG indices, ASEAN CG Scorecard) — a public-evidence reconstruction of the ESG Momentum 2.0 foundation basket
